entities.summary: Greek, a notable figure in the history of Türkiye, associated with Turkish War of Independence and Republic (1919–1923). Preceded by War of Independence and Treaty of Lausanne. Their legacy influenced Great Offensive — Turkish forces defeat the Greek army at Dumlupınar and Republic of Turkey proclaimed with Ankara as capital.
